checks.method: Resolve `pi` on PATH and record its reported version as the runtime identity.

checks.title: Pi executes a canonical Workflow JS spec
checks.method: Scan Pi's documented command surface for an entrypoint that loads and runs a spec file.
checks.evidence: Pi exposes no Workflow-spec execution entrypoint. Documented commands are ['--continue', '--exclude-tools', '--export', '--model', '--models', '--name', '--provider', '--thinking', '--tools', '-p', 'auth', 'config', 'install', 'list', 'remove', 'uninstall', 'update']; the surface is an interactive/`--print` coding assistant with extensions, skills, prompt templates, and sessions. 'workflow' appears in `pi --help`: False. A canonical spec (`export const meta = {...}` first statement plus a top-level async body) has no loader.

checks.title: Pi injects the ADR-0006 orchestration globals
checks.method: Probe the Pi launcher and help surface for the canonical spec marker and injected globals.
checks.evidence: /Users/malte/.local/bin/pi contains no `export const meta` spec marker and Pi documents no injected orchestration globals ['agent', 'pipeline', 'parallel', 'phase', 'budget', 'args', 'workflow']. Pi's unit of model work is an AgentSession created by extension TypeScript, not a leaf `agent(prompt, opts)` call injected into an inert JavaScript spine.

checks.title: Pi journals leaf calls and resumes a crashed run
checks.method: Distinguish conversational session resume from a (prompt, opts)-keyed orchestration journal.
checks.evidence: Pi resumes conversational SESSIONS (`--continue`/`--resume` present: True), not orchestration runs. ADR-0006 requires a journal keyed by a hash of (prompt, opts) per `agent()` call so a re-run with the same script and args is a full cache hit and a crashed run resumes at the failed leaf. Pi exposes no such run journal, because it has no leaf-call abstraction to key one on.

checks.title: The Pi orchestration spine is inert
checks.method: Inspect the Cognovis Pi harness design for orchestration-layer filesystem, shell, or VCS side effects.
checks.evidence: /Users/malte/code/library/cognovis-pi/docs/native-executive-pack-harness.md places ['Git and Beads adapters', 'Evidence store', 'Beads adapter'] inside the orchestration extension itself. ADR-0006 Decision 4 makes an inert spine normative: the orchestration layer has no filesystem, no shell, and no network. A host that executes git, Beads, and gate side effects is the acting layer and the deciding layer at once, which is the exact separation ADR-0006 exists to enforce.

checks.title: Installed workflow receipts have a defined Pi migration
checks.method: Inventory workflow catalog entries and lockfile receipts and look for a defined Pi target path.
checks.evidence: 5 workflow catalog entries, 0 lockfile workflow receipts, and 4 materialized harness projections (['bead-context-pack.js', 'bead-review.js', 'quick-fix.js', 'stream-review.js']) were found. The installer's workflow type still targets `workflows/` as Claude workflow JavaScript (scripts/lib/primitives.py: install_subdir='workflows'). No Pi target path, receipt re-key rule, or re-materialization rule is defined for any of them, so migration is undefined rather than merely incomplete. The projections that exist are additionally unreceipted, so a cutover has nothing to migrate FROM in lock terms.

checks.title: The native parse-check deploy gate has a Pi replacement
checks.method: Inspect the workflow installer for the ADR-0006 native gate and any Pi-side equivalent.
checks.evidence: /Users/malte/code/.worktrees/library-platform/CL-2p73-heterogeneous-marketplace-workspaces/scripts/lib/installers/simple_file.py enforces the ADR-0006 native parse gate (meta-first textual check plus `node --check`): present=True. No Pi-side equivalent exists, so superseding ADR-0006 today would delete a working deploy gate and replace it with nothing.

checks.title: A rollback path to the ADR-0006 executor is reachable
checks.method: Inspect the Library runtime adapter-preservation registry for an executor that may run mutating work.
checks.evidence: /Users/malte/code/.worktrees/library-platform/CL-2p73-heterogeneous-marketplace-workspaces/scripts/lib/workflow_runtime.py carries the fail-closed adapter registry (present=True) with verified adapters=[] and blocked adapters=['claude-agent', 'codex-exec', 'codex-impl']. No adapter is approved for mutating execution, so the ADR-0006 fallback is itself read-only. A rollback target that cannot run mutating work is not a rollback path for a superseded executor; it is the reason ADR-0006 must be retained rather than replaced.

threshold: Supersede ADR-0006 only when all of ['PWE-2', 'PWE-3', 'PWE-4', 'PWE-5'] (constitutive) and ['PWE-6', 'PWE-7', 'PWE-8'] (migration completeness) record `pass`. Any `fail` or `unavailable` retains ADR-0006.
